create_mock_object: create a mock object from a class using Mox().CreateMock(MyClass) for unit testing
stub_out_with_mock: stub out a module attribute with a mock using Mox().StubOutWithMock(module, 'attr_name')
create_mock_anything: create a mock that accepts any method call using Mox().CreateMockAnything() without enforcing an interface
mock_method_and_return: set a mock method's return value using mock_dao.RetrievePerson('1').AndReturn(person)
use_comparator_is_a: use IsA(MyClass) as a mock method parameter to verify the argument type at replay time
mock_method_and_raise: make a mock method raise an exception using mock_dao.RunQuery().AndRaise(MyException())
use_str_contains_comparator: use StrContains('substring') as a mock parameter to verify a string contains expected text
use_in_any_order: group mock method calls to occur in any order using mock_dao.MethodA().InAnyOrder('group1')
use_multiple_times: allow mock method calls to repeat using mock_dao.MethodA().MultipleTimes('group1')
use_mox_test_base: subclass MoxTestBase to get automatic mock verification and stub cleanup on every test method
use_regex_comparator: use Regex(pattern) as a mock parameter to verify a string matches a regular expression
use_ignore_arg_comparator: use IgnoreArg() as a mock parameter to skip validation of a specific argument
use_func_comparator: use Func(my_validator) as a mock parameter to run a custom callable for argument validation
use_same_elements_as_comparator: use SameElementsAs(['a','b']) to verify an iterable contains the same elements regardless of order
use_and_or_comparators: combine comparators with And(IsA(str), StrContains('hello')) or Or(IsA(int), IsA(float)) for flexible matching
